content.text:
I finished the quest, "The Deepest Hall", and I now carry all three Seal-Stones of the Kings.

I lifted the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var in the outer yard of Vorannuhl without being seen. The key opened the Vault of the Household. The Lord of Vorannuhl was in the vault, but it did not attack. I took the third stone from the Household's Hoard without fighting.

The journal says to bring the stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom. The gate at the drowned Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth is where all three eventually go.

Still unanswered:
- Why the Unbound seal the trees.
- What moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, and where its key is.
- How Nesh-Deeka knows about the Unbound.
- What the Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is after.

I gave the game my final notes, and it has ended.
